query:
insert into TestRunLineCoverageOverrides (
                                collect_nr,
                                product_id,
                                test_collect_nr,
                                test_run_name,
                                test_run_date,
                                review_name,
                                review_date,
                                cov_filepath,
                                cov_line,
                                hits,
                                comment_hash
                            )
                            select
                                $1,
                                $2,
                                tr.collect_nr,
                                $3,
                                $4,
                                $5,
                                $6,
                                $7,
                                $8,
                                $9,
                                $10
                            from TestRuns tr
                            where tr.collect_nr = (
                                select max(ctr.collect_nr)
                                from TestRuns ctr
                                where ctr.product_id = tr.product_id
                            )
                            and tr.product_id = $2
                            and tr.name = $3
                            and tr.utc_date = $4
